_comment: Items lettered on the A4 drawing or schematic with no row in the 1983 Table 5-5. CR2 is
the reference zener the drawing and schematic print where the 1983 parts list has CR4;
its stock number and value are the May 1986 manual's Table 5-5 row VR2 (1N4571, 6.4 V,
Fluke 330829), which settles the 7/85 errata's 'VR1, VR2, VR9 all 1N5240'. Kept as CR2
to match the 1983 drawings. See docs/review-notes.md.

components.desc: Edge connector, 27 contacts, mates A2 J2 (motherboard)

components.notes: Reference zener beside C2 (82 uF) at the Q1/Q2 error amplifier. Row from the May 1986 manual's Table 5-5, where it is VR2; the 1983 table lists the same part (same stock number) as CR4, the 7/85 errata's 'all 1N5240' for VR2 is superseded
components.src: Table 5-5 of the May 1986 manual (VR2, PDF p60); Figure 8-4

amend.notes: VR1 from Rev C (Errata Change #2); the May 1986 Table 5-5 lists VR1 as 1N5240 (473744)
VR9 from Rev C (Errata Change #2); the May 1986 Table 5-5 lists VR9 as 1N5240 (473744)
not printed on the board drawing or schematic, which letter this 6.4 V reference zener CR2; the May 1986 Table 5-5 lists it as VR2 (see CR2 and the CR2/CR4 caveat)
